items.summaryZh: 迈凯伦将在本周末巴西大奖赛为MCL40带来升级，其中包括预计将用于2027年赛车的全新前翼概念。车队在匈牙利大幅升级后由诺里斯连赢两场，但此后在竞争中有所回落。

items.originalTitle: McLaren to introduce 2027 F1 front wing at Brazil GP
items.summaryEn: McLaren will bring upgrades to its MCL40 at this weekend's Brazil Grand Prix, including a new front wing concept expected to feature on its 2027 challenger. The team had surged forward after a substantial upgrade in Hungary, with Lando Norris winning there and at Zandvoort, but has since slipped back in the pecking order.
detailZh: 迈凯伦将在巴西大奖赛引入2027款F1前翼
迈凯伦将在英特拉格斯赛道进一步升级其2026款赛车，部分部件应会沿用到下一年度的赛车
迈凯伦将在本周末的巴西大奖赛为其MCL40一级方程式赛车带来升级，其中包括一个预计将用于其2027款赛车的前翼概念。
车队在匈牙利对MCL40进行大幅升级后曾冲到前列，兰多·诺里斯赢下了那场比赛以及随后的赞德沃特站，但此后尽管在巴库引入了又一套全面升级方案、在奥斯汀带来更多新部件，车队在竞争顺序中仍有所回落。
在最近四节排位赛中，迈凯伦拥有第四快的赛车，平均落后杆位0.511秒，落后第三快的挑战者0.236秒，但仍在努力改进MCL40——同时着眼于2027年。
“作为我们正常研发周期的一部分，我们为赛车带来了一些更新，涉及前翼、后翼和一些底板部件，”首席技术官（空气动力学）彼得·普罗德罗穆说。“目标是缩小差距，在剩余比赛中提升我们的表现，并为明年积累势头。
“圣保罗过去对我们来说是一条不错的赛道，也是一条相当有代表性的赛道，所以我们希望这些升级能帮助我们再向前迈进一步。
彼得·普罗德罗穆，迈凯伦技术总监（空气动力学）
“赛季尚未结束：这些升级旨在立即提升赛车性能，并帮助我们在争夺年度第三名的战斗中取得优势。虽然我们从这些升级中获得的经验将用于明年的开发，但我们还期望将新前翼的概念延续到明年赛车的发布规格中。”
迈凯伦目前落后第三名红牛17分，但在过去五轮比赛中仅获得59分，而对手获得了152分。
墨西哥站的比赛仍然令人鼓舞，诺里斯获得第五名，仅落后分站冠军马克斯·维斯塔潘12秒，但这位卫冕世界冠军对接下来几轮比赛并不乐观。
“如果我们看看巴库和其他比赛，我认为我们在速度上仍会挣扎，”他在周日晚上表示。“因此，我们仍然需要在某些赛道和某些方面对赛车进行大幅改进。”
“今天情况不错，但我不认为如果我们回到那些我们挣扎过的赛道，就会突然变好。只是今天适合我们，但我不想在性能上依赖一点希望和运气。
“我们知道需要改进什么，这需要时间，希望我们在巴西能有更好的一天。”
detailEn: McLaren to introduce 2027 F1 front wing at Brazil GP
McLaren will further update its 2026 car at Interlagos, with parts that should carry over to next year’s challenger
McLaren will introduce upgrades to its MCL40 Formula 1 car at this weekend’s Brazil Grand Prix, featuring a front wing concept which is expected to feature on its 2027 challenger.

The team had surged to the front when it substantially updated the MCL40 in Hungary, with Lando Norris winning that race and the following one at Zandvoort, but it has since slipped back in the pecking order despite introducing another comprehensive upgrade package in Baku and further new parts in Austin.

McLaren had the fourth-quickest car in the last four qualifying sessions, with a 0.511s deficit to pole position and a 0.236s gap to the third-fastest challenger on average, but is still working away at improving the MCL40 – with an eye on 2027.

“We’ve got some updates coming to the car across the front wing, rear wing and some floor components as part of our normal development cycle,” said Peter Prodromou, chief technical officer, aerodynamics. “The aim is to make up ground, improve our performance over the remaining races and build momentum into next year.
“Sao Paulo has been a good circuit for us in the past and is a fairly representative track, so we’re hopeful these upgrades can help us take another step towards the front.
Peter Prodromou, McLaren Technical Director Aerodynamics

“The season isn't over yet: these upgrades are designed to improve the car now and help us in our fight for third in the championship. While the learning we take from these upgrades will feed into next year’s development, we also expect to carry over the concept of the new front wing into the launch specification of next year’s car.”
McLaren has a 17-point deficit to third-placed Red Bull but has scored just 59 points to its rival’s 152 across the last five rounds.
The Mexican race was still encouraging, with Norris taking fifth just 12 seconds adrift of race winner Max Verstappen, yet the reigning world champion wasn’t optimistic for the next few rounds.
“If we look at Baku and stuff, I think we're still going to be struggling for pace,” he said on Sunday evening. “So we need to improve the car in certain tracks and certain areas still a lot more.

“Today it was good, but I'm not convinced that if we go back to the tracks we struggled at we'd be good all of a sudden. It's just today suited us, but I don't want to rely on a bit of hope and luck on performance.
“We know what we need to improve on, it just takes time, and hopefully we can have a better day in Brazil.”
keyPointsZh: 迈凯伦将在英特拉格斯赛道为2026款赛车带来更多升级，部分部件预计将沿用到下一年度的赛车。
车队在匈牙利大幅升级MCL40后由诺里斯夺冠，并在随后的赞德沃特再赢一场。
尽管在巴库引入又一套全面升级、在奥斯汀带来更多新部件，车队此后在竞争顺序中有所回落。

items.originalTitle: Red Bull's rumoured €27million deal takes shape in leaked Max Verstappen shoot
detailZh: 红牛车队传闻的2.7亿欧元合同在泄露的马克斯·维斯塔潘照片中成形
泄露的照片显示马克斯·维斯塔潘身穿阿迪达斯装备在小红牛22赛车上，进一步证实了每年2.7百万欧元的红牛合同传闻
对于红牛车队的粉丝来说，关注红牛车队，了解F1新闻、车手更新、技术洞察和米尔顿凯恩斯的比赛分析
一次商业拍摄意外地加剧了目前在F1车队中最大的场外传闻
泄露的照片在社交媒体上流传，显示马克斯·维斯塔潘随意地靠在小红牛22赛车的前左轮上，身上穿着预计将发布的未上市车队装备。红牛明星的胸前和肩膀上清晰地展示着标志性的阿迪达斯标志和三条杠设计，完全取代了目前的Castore品牌。
品牌大换血不仅限于服装。仔细观察泄露的套图可以发现，一个显眼的白色阿迪达斯标志直接印在小红牛22的侧面。
关于德国运动巨头窃取米尔顿凯恩斯车队的第一手消息在今年初引起了广泛关注。BILD的初步报道表明，这两大巨头正在协商一份价值巨大的商品和服装合同，该合同将于2027赛季生效。
传闻中的交易金额令人震惊。据报道，该协议每年价值约2700万欧元，将赛车队锁定在三条杠生态系统中至少三个赛季。
接管红牛的盈利性商品运营将是阿迪达斯在赛车运动扩张中的一次重大升级。这个服装品牌已经深度渗透到赛车阵容中，并现在正打算将这家奥地利巨头添加到不断增长的F1组合中，该组合包括梅赛德斯-奔驰和奥迪。
尽管明星车手被摄像头捕捉到穿着实物装备，但赛车服装和运动服高管们还没有发布官方新闻稿确认2027年的转变。直到公开签署，Castore仍然是官方供应商。
detailEn: Red Bull's rumoured €27million deal takes shape in leaked Max Verstappen shoot
Leaked photos show Max Verstappen wearing Adidas gear on his RB22, fueling rumours of a €27M per year Red Bull deal
For Red Bull fans. Keeping watch on Red Bull Racing, with F1 news, driver updates, technical insight and race analysis from Milton Keynes.
A commercial production shoot just accidentally poured gasoline on one of the biggest off-track rumours in the Formula 1 paddock right now.

Leaked photographs circulating across social media show Max Verstappen casually resting on the front left wheel of his RB22 while sporting what is expected to be an unreleased team kit. Displayed crystal clear on the right side of the Red Bull star's chest and across his shoulders is the iconic Adidas logo and three-stripe design, completely replacing the current Castore branding.
The branding overhaul wasn't limited to the apparel. A closer look at the leaked set photos reveals a prominent white Adidas logo stamped directly onto the side of the RB22.

Whispers of the German sportswear juggernaut poaching the Milton Keynes squad first gained serious traction earlier this year. Initial reports from BILD indicated that the two powerhouses were negotiating a massive merchandise and apparel contract set to take effect for the 2027 F1 season.

The financials of the rumoured deal is staggering. The agreement is reportedly worth approximately €27 million per year, locking the racing outfit into the three-stripe ecosystem for at least three seasons.

Taking over Red Bull's lucrative merchandise operations would serve as a massive escalation in Adidas's aggressive motorsport expansion. The apparel brand has already heavily infiltrated the grid and is now looking to add the Austrian powerhouse to a growing F1 portfolio that includes Mercedes and Audi.

While the star driver was caught on camera wearing the physical gear, neither the racing outfit nor the sportswear executives have issued an official press release confirming the 2027 switch. Until the ink is publicly dry, Castore remains the official supplier.
keyPointsZh: 照片中维斯塔潘穿着疑似未发布的团队服装
照片流出疑似揭示了维斯塔潘与车队的新合同
keyPointsEn: The photos are believed to reveal a new deal with Red Bull
The images were accidentally leaked during a commercial shoot

items.summaryZh: 哈德贾在墨西哥大奖赛中起步顺利，但随后被乔治·拉塞尔推离赛道。

items.originalTitle: Isack Hadjar rues missed opportunity after George Russell clash at Mexico GP
detailZh: 哈贾尔 在墨西哥大奖赛与乔治·拉塞尔的碰撞后遗憾错失良机
哈贾尔 分享他在墨西哥城大奖赛混乱的经过，乔治·拉塞尔的碰撞破坏了他的前五名起步
对于红牛车队的粉丝来说，关注红牛车队，了解F1新闻、车手更新、技术洞察和米尔顿凯恩斯的比赛分析
人生中完美的起步，却在几个弯道后被推离赛道，这是毁掉一个周日的好方法。问问伊萨克·哈德贾吧。
在阿特奥多莫·赫尔曼诺斯·罗德里格斯赛道上发车排在第七位，红牛车手完成了一次完美的起步。他猛烈地切入车队，通过开场几个弯道就确立了第五名的位置，看起来准备大捞积分。但他在6号弯的早期势头被阻止了。
在自身糟糕的起步后，乔治·罗素拼命想要追回失去的地盘，将他的梅赛德斯赛车推到内侧。这次攻击导致法国车手在车队尾部翻车。尽管国际汽联 stewards 给梅赛德斯车手判了10秒的罚时，但这对红牛的赛车策略造成的损害已经无法挽回。
尘埃落定后，在维修区接受采访时，这位22岁的年轻人没有掩饰他对错失机会的沮丧。
“今天真的很遗憾，”哈吉尔解释道。“我们知道赛车在比赛中是有速度的，所以我们只想专注于一个好的起步，这正是我们做到的。我设法升到了第五位，并在前几个弯道中感觉非常强劲。”
对于米尔顿凯恩斯的车库来说，不幸的是，随着拉塞尔的前翼进入制动区，那份早期的信心瞬间蒸发了。
“不幸的是，乔治在T6处内线打滑，我直接被送到了最后，”他抱怨道。“从那时起，要重新回到积分榜就变得非常困难了。”
被迫完全放弃最初的策略，车队维修区掷骰子般地将其车手换到了中性胎，以寻找干净的空间。虽然小红牛22显然拥有原始的速度，但墨西哥城赛道的紧凑布局使得在中场突破变得异常艰难。
更糟糕的是，赛车之神似乎还没有结束它的坏运气。
“我们停在了中停区，在自由空气中，我能感觉到速度，但在这条赛道上超车非常困难，”这位年轻的车手详细描述道。“我们运气不好，安全车的时机不对，然后在第二次发车时，我又因为被逼到草地上而再次后退。”
“尽管第一圈发生了打滑，糟糕的警告时机，以及在混乱的发车中被推离赛道，哈吉亚仍然设法挣扎着回到了第九位。展望三连赛的最后一场，红牛车队知道他们有实力反弹。”
“这不是一个理想的周末，但赛车非常快，我们的起步也很不错，所以进入巴西肯定有积极的一面，”他总结道。
detailEn: Isack Hadjar rues missed opportunity after George Russell clash at Mexico GP
Isack Hadjar breaks down his chaotic Mexico City GP after George Russell clash ruined his top-five start
For Red Bull fans. Keeping watch on Red Bull Racing, with F1 news, driver updates, technical insight and race analysis from Milton Keynes.
Nailing the launch of your life only to get pushed off the track a few corners later is a surefire way to ruin a Sunday. Just ask Isack Hadjar.

Starting seventh on the grid at the Autódromo Hermanos Rodríguez, the Red Bull driver executed a flawless getaway. He aggressively sliced through the pack to secure fifth place through the opening sequence of corners, looking primed for a massive haul of points. But that early momentum was halted at Turn 6.

Desperately trying to make up ground after his own poor launch, George Russell threw his Mercedes up the inside. The resulting attack sent the Frenchman spinning into the abyss at the back of the pack. While the FIA stewards slapped the Mercedes driver with a 10-second penalty, the damage to Red Bull's race strategy was already permanent.
Speaking in the paddock after the dust settled, the 22-year-old made no secret of his frustration over the missed opportunity.

"Today was a real shame," Hadjar explained. "We knew there was pace in the car coming into the race, so we just wanted to focus on getting a good start, and that’s exactly what we did. I managed to get up to fifth and felt really strong through the first few corners."
Sadly for the Milton Keynes garage, that early confidence evaporated the second Russell's front wing arrived in the braking zone.
"Unfortunately, George stuck a wheel up the inside at T6, and I was sent straight to the back," he lamented. "From then on, it was going to be so difficult to get back into the points."

Forced to completely abandon its initial strategy, the pitwall rolled the dice and swapped its driver onto the medium compound to hunt for clean air. While the RB22 clearly had the raw pace, the tight layout of the Mexico City circuit makes cutting through the midfield a grueling task.
To make matters worse, the racing gods weren't done dealing out bad luck.

"We pitted onto the Medium, and in the free air, I could feel the pace, but overtaking on this track is very tricky," the young charger detailed. "We got unlucky with the Safety Car timing, and then, on the second restart, I went backwards again as I got closed onto the grass."

Despite the Lap 1 spin, the terrible caution timings, and getting shoved off the tarmac during a chaotic restart, Hadjar still managed to claw his way back to ninth. Looking ahead to the final leg of the triple-header, the Red Bull camp knows they have the firepower to bounce back.
"It’s not been an ideal weekend, but the car was very fast, and our starts were good, so there are definitely positives heading into Brazil," he concluded.

被拉塞尔推离赛道，错失机会
keyPointsEn: He executed a perfect getaway and was in fifth place early on
He was pushed off the track by George Russell and missed an opportunity

items.titleZh: 安东内利："我在基米澳大利亚事故后看到了冠军的气质"
items.summaryZh: 安东内利成为F1历史上最年轻的世界冠军，成为自1953年阿尔贝托·阿斯卡里以来首位赢得冠军的意大利人。他的父亲，前赛车手和AKM赛车运动车队负责人，在独家采访中讨论了基米的发展、他处理压力的能力以及他意识到儿子能够成为冠军的时刻。
